opening.title: The first week of every SaaS,
opening.description: Auth, database, AI, translations and tests come wired. Scaffold a project in a minute, sign into your own dashboard within the hour, and spend the week on your product — not on groundwork.

friction.title: The first weeks always disappear into the same work
friction.description: Sign-in flows, folder structure, test runners, Docker. None of it makes your product different, and all of it can go wrong. Here is what the template takes off your plate.

auth.name: Authentication
auth.starter: Better Auth and Clerk arrive pre-configured. Database sessions work in minutes.
auth.scratch: A day or two lost to endpoints, JWTs, cookie flags, middleware and user tables.

architecture.name: Architecture
architecture.starter: Self-contained modules behind one barrel import. New features can't tangle with old ones.
architecture.scratch: A folder layout improvised under deadline, refactored painfully six months in.

tests.name: Testing
tests.starter: Vitest and Playwright run out of the box, with smoke tests covering real routes.
tests.scratch: Hours of config files, runners, database seeding and CI before the first useful test.

ai.name: AI streaming
ai.starter: Server-sent events and a chat UI are already built, with five providers to choose from.
ai.scratch: Hand-rolling chunk parsing, retry logic and streaming state for every provider.

docker.name: Deployment
docker.starter: Multi-profile Docker Compose for the app, Postgres and ChromaDB, ready for any VPS.
docker.scratch: Writing Dockerfiles and compose files by hand, then debugging them in production.

firstMinute.title: One command. A real codebase.
firstMinute.description: Not an empty folder — a typed monolith with twelve modules, migrations and CI hooks, named after your product.
firstMinute.terminalAria: Terminal output of the scaffolding command

appShell.title: App Shell
appShell.description: Theme, sidebar navigation, dialogs and responsive layout.

modules.title: Domain Modules
modules.description: Users, settings, dashboard widgets and a streaming AI chat — each one isolated.

integrations.title: Integrations & QA
integrations.description: Better Auth, Drizzle ORM, Playwright and Vitest, configured and talking to each other.

firstHour.title: Sign in to a product that already works
firstHour.description: Before the hour is out you are clicking through your own app: real sign-in, a live dashboard, an AI chat answering over SSE. The screens below are the template, untouched.

mock.workspaceSubtitle: Sign in to the app you scaffolded an hour ago.

fiveDays.title: Five days from first commit to production
fiveDays.description: A realistic path, not a countdown. Each day has a goal, a handful of tasks and the exact command to run. Tick them off as you go.

day1.title: Environment
day1.subtitle: Clone the repository, copy the example env file and check that the dev server boots.
tasks: Install dependencies and open the dev server

day2.title: Brand
day2.subtitle: Make it yours: colors, logo and navigation.
tasks: Adjust the OKLCH palette in globals.css

day3.title: Auth & data
day3.subtitle: Wire your credentials and shape the database.
tasks: Define your domain schema with Drizzle

day4.title: Your product
day4.subtitle: The fun part: routes, widgets and AI for your actual domain.
tasks: Add your routes under the router tree
Point the AI chat at your provider

day5.title: Ship
day5.subtitle: Prove it works, then put it in front of people.
tasks: Bring up the Docker Compose stack

structure.title: Structure
structure.statement: Every feature lives in its own module, behind one import.
structure.proof: Twelve modules ship today. Deleting one doesn't break the others.

security.title: Security
security.statement: Auth, roles and configuration are decided before your first feature — not after your first incident.
security.proof: Better Auth sessions, RBAC and typed env access come wired.

longevity.title: Longevity
longevity.statement: Swap the brand, the modules and the copy. The architecture is built to outlive them.
longevity.proof: This landing is itself a module you could replace this afternoon.

contact.title: Questions before you clone?
contact.description: Write to us about the template — a setup problem, a missing feature, an architectural doubt. Your message lands in the same contact-messages module that ships with the starter.
contact.responseNote: We usually answer within a couple of days.

message.label: Your message
message.placeholder: What are you building, and where can we help?

messages.successDescription: Thanks for writing. It's in our inbox — and in the demo dashboard.
messages.errorDescription: Please try again in a moment.

github.title: Open repository
github.description: Bugs and feature requests live as GitHub issues. The roadmap is public.

async.title: Async by default
async.description: No calls, no meetings. Write when it suits you; we answer the same way.

updates.title: Low-volume updates
updates.description: Release notes land in your inbox at most once a month.
